notes: Genuinely thin after extensive search, though not for lack of trying. Nigeria's fashion retail/thrift ('okrika'/'bend-down-select') content is almost entirely on TikTok (haul videos, wholesale-vendor promos, 'how much I spent' content) rather than YouTube or structured blogs. One excellent near-miss: Honey Ogundeyi, founder of Fashpa.com (Nigeria's pioneer online fashion retailer), launched a real, Wikipedia-documented entrepreneurial vlog called 'Side Hustle to Empire' in 2017 specifically to teach how she built her retail business — but no current, direct YouTube channel URL/ID could be confirmed (the only surviving reference is an archived 2018 Wayback Machine link), so it wasn't counted rather than guess at a channel that may no longer be live or findable. Several real publications cover this space (3niter's Corner, Ekinken, The Nigerian Observer) but none had a confirmable RSS feed this round. Worth a dedicated future pass — possibly TikTok-focused given where this specific business's content actually lives, which is a genuinely different content landscape than most other categories in this project.
